title: Hugging Face 推出售价 400 美元的会唱歌、会滑冰的鸭子机器人
summary: Artificial intelligence platform Hugging Face Inc. unveiled a singing $400 bipedal robot that can be taught tricks, the latest in the company’s ongoing effort to make AI and robotics more approachable to the general public.The cute robot — aptly named Microduck — takes clear inspiration from its namesake bird, except that it has only one eye. It will go on sale later this year, Hugging Face said Thursday, making it the second robot from the company.（原题：Hugging Face Unveils $400 Singing, Skating Duck-Like Robot）
